sections.label: Middle-income economies reaching high income
sections.summary: Since 1990, fewer than one in three of the world's middle-income economies has reached high income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Since 1990, fewer than one in three of the world's middle-income economies has made it to high income.

sections.label: ASEAN trade and external demand
sections.summary: ASEAN trades with itself about 21% versus the EU's 60%, and about three-quarters of exports depend on external demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) still trades with itself only about a fifth as much as it trades with the world – 21%, against the European Union's 60%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And about three-quarters of our exports depend on external demand, just as the great powers begin wielding access to their markets as instruments of coercion.

sections.label: SkyeChip Malaysian IPO
sections.summary: Penang chip designer SkyeChip listed this year 95 times oversubscribed, Malaysia's largest IPO in 16 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A Penang chip designer, SkyeChip, listed this year 95 times oversubscribed, the largest Malaysian initial public offering in 16 years.

sections.label: JS-SEZ and RTS Link
sections.summary: The Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone and the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link are new instruments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: New instruments in front of us: the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ), and the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link (RTS Link).

sections.label: Malaysia National Semiconductor Strategy
sections.summary: Its National Semiconductor Strategy centres on indigenous IC design, with RM25 billion and a 60,000-engineer training goal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Its National Semiconductor Strategy puts indigenous IC design – about half of a chip's value-added – at the centre, with RM25 billion behind it and a 60,000-engineer training goal.

sections.label: MTI design-to-fab-to-packaging chain
sections.summary: MTI should foster a design-to-fab-to-packaging chain through Singapore, with structured prototyping tied to investor stakes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: First, I believe MTI should foster a design-to-fab-to-packaging chain that runs through Singapore – access and equity as one instrument: structured prototyping on the fabs hosted here and packaging lines, tied to a stake for our investors, public and private.

sections.label: Talent pipeline and joint business entity
sections.summary: Proposes universities set up an embedded institute in Selangor with joint credentials, and a recognised Malaysia-Singapore business entity with minimum stakes on each side.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Second, the talent pipeline: our universities, the Nanyang Technological University and National University of Singapore, should seek to set up an embedded institute in the Selangor cluster carrying a joint credential, with firms operating on both sides of the zone sponsoring net-new training places whose employment options are exercisable in Johor, Selangor or Singapore, producing new engineers for the region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Third, I believe we should recognise in law a Malaysia-Singapore business entity, defined by a minimum stake on each side – 30-30, 40-40, 50-50 – and give it closer-to-local, pseudo-local treatment in both countries' grants, financing and procurements.

sections.label: RTS impact on Singapore retail
sections.summary: Notes gallows humour among shops about the RTS, with DBS putting leakage at $1.5 to $2.1 billion a year, hitting food and personal services hardest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The provision shop, the Traditional Chinese Medicine shop, the noodle stall, the barber, the tailor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: There is gallows humour in those shops now about the RTS and what it will do to Singapore retail; and a question: "When the RTS opens, what will happen to us?" DBS puts the leakage at $1.5 to $2.1 billion a year – 3% to 4% of retail sales, everyday with food and personal services hit hardest.

sections.label: Equity stake and retailer entitlements
sections.summary: Proposes Singapore take equity in transit-oriented developments and negotiate reserved positions for small retailers, giving exposed renters a tradeable entitlement or cash floor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Singapore should take an equity stake in some of these transit-oriented developments the line creates – Bukit Chagar and the 32 e-ART stations – and negotiate, in the same deal, reserved positions for our small retailers inside those developments, inside the podium of those malls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Khazanah and Temasek formed a joint company, 60:40, and built Marina One and DUO in the city centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The footfall these developments capture is largely from Singapore, so the deal has logic on both sides: Johor gains a committed capital partner for a network it is building anyway; we gain a share of where our own spending lands and a place in it for the retailers that spending leaves behind.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Thus, we can give every exposed small retailer who rents rather than owns their premises – on the order of 40,000 provision shops, eateries, personal-care operators and so on – a tradeable entitlement: a priority claim on a reserved position in these developments, to take up or assign to another small operator.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Or for those who would rather not move, a cash floor drawn now or set against rent – enough to fund a real relocation or a year of rent.

sections.label: Stakeholder economy and regional integration
sections.summary: Describes a model of integration with the region that maximises Southeast Asia's 15 to 20 years before it ages out of its demographic dividend.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And the fostering of a stakeholder economy and the search for a better bargain for our pioneering generations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is the model of integration I believe we should seek with the region – one that best maximises the 15 to 20 years Southeast Asia has before it ages out of its demographic dividend.

sections.label: JS-SEZ overview and boundaries
sections.summary: States the JS-SEZ spans about 3,500 square kilometres, includes Iskandar Development Region and Pengerang, and aims to create value together.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: But let me first give an overview about the JS-SEZ.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: It spans about 3,500 square kilometres, it includes Iskandar Development Region and Pengerang.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: I wanted to point out to the Member that, in fact, the boundaries of the JS-SEZ are available online.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: But the whole point about the JS-SEZ is about creating value together that neither side would have created or captured alone.

sections.label: Measures to reduce friction
sections.summary: States both sides introduced measures to reduce friction and improve connectivity in immigration clearance, customs facilitation and cargo processes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Both sides have also introduced measures to reduce friction and improve connectivity, including in immigration clearance, customs facilitation and cargo processes.

sections.label: Twinning Singapore and Johor operations
sections.summary: Singapore companies can keep HQ, financing, innovation and branding functions in Singapore while using Johor's strengths to scale competitively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: In Singapore, for Singapore companies, the true value is being able to twin operations: keeping the HQ functions, financing, innovation, branding and higher-value functions in Singapore, while using Johor's complementary strengths to scale more competitively.

sections.label: Singapore in semiconductor value chain
sections.summary: Singapore accounts for one in five semiconductor equipment manufacturing and one in 10 semiconductor chips.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Singapore is a key node in the global semiconductor value chain.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We account for one out of five in every semiconductor equipment manufacturing and one out of 10 of semiconductor chips.

sections.label: Singapore-Malaysia Johor investment targets
sections.summary: Singapore and Malaysia agreed to attract 50 projects in five years and 100 in 10 years, with over $5.5 billion committed to Johor since January 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Singapore and Malaysia have jointly agreed to attract 50 projects in five years and 100 projects in 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Last year, Johor recorded its highest ever approved investments, with over 70% of those investments attributed to the zone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: Since signing the Memorandum of Understanding in January 2024, Singapore and Singapore-based companies have committed over $5.5 billion in investments into Johor.

sections.label: Sharing findings and recommendations
sections.summary: The speaker says this can be promoted further so commerce flows both ways, with findings and recommendations shared later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: And I think this is something which we can promote further to ensure that commerce flows on both sides.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan)
sentences.text: We will be sharing our findings and recommendations later this year.
